title: ReadinessStatusView
description: The view `alixai readiness status` shows (master plan 9.5, ADR 0037): the checklist re-evaluated against the latest stored report, with what is met, partial, missing, unverified or contradicted and what changed since the report before it. It is a read-only, advisory view: it is not an audit result, and no field in it is a pass, a grant, a permission or an approval.

schema_version.description: The contract generation of this document.

advisory.description: Always true: the view is advice to the operator, not a certification and not an audit result.

report_id.description: The stored report the view was evaluated from.

evaluated_at.description: When the checklist was re-evaluated for this view.

previous_report_id.description: The report before the stored one. Absent when there is none.

inputs_changed.description: True when the project files, the catalog or the scan options no longer hash to the stored report's inputs, so the report is stale and a new scan is due.

mode.description: deterministic_only: the stored report was made without a model. deterministic_and_model: a model proposed findings that the verifier checked.

summary.description: How many items are in each status.

items.description: One entry per catalog requirement, in catalog order.

item.description: The current status of one requirement and how it changed.

check_id.description: The audit check the requirement feeds.

level.description: Whether the requirement is mandatory or recommended.

previous_status.description: The status in the report before. Absent when there is no earlier report or the requirement is new.

changed.description: True when the status differs from previous_status or the requirement is new since the earlier report.
